title: Cleopatra never saw the pyramids being built
hook: Cleopatra never saw the pyramids being built.
script: She lived closer in time to the Moon landing than to the building of the Great Pyramid. About two thousand five hundred years separate her from the pyramid, but only about two thousand from Apollo eleven.

title: Oxford is older than the Aztec Empire
hook: Oxford University is older than the Aztec Empire.
script: Teaching at Oxford began around ten ninety six. The Aztec city of Tenochtitlan was founded in thirteen twenty five. The university was already two centuries old.

title: Napoleon was defeated by rabbits
hook: Napoleon was once defeated by rabbits.
script: In eighteen oh seven he organized a rabbit hunt. The rabbits were tame, so they charged at him instead of running away. His men reportedly had to retreat.

title: Roman concrete heals itself
script: Researchers found tiny lime chunks inside it. When cracks form and water seeps in, they dissolve and seal the crack. That is why Roman buildings still stand today.

title: An army lost a war to birds
hook: An army once lost a war to birds.
script: In nineteen thirty two, Australia sent soldiers with machine guns against emus destroying farmland. The emus kept scattering, and the army withdrew. The birds won.

title: Star Wars came out before the last guillotine execution
hook: Star Wars came out before the last guillotine execution.
script: France's last guillotine execution happened in September nineteen seventy seven. Star Wars premiered in May of the same year.

title: One man crashed Egypt's economy
hook: One man crashed the economy of Egypt.
script: In thirteen twenty four, Mansa Musa of Mali traveled to Mecca with so much gold that he gave it away along the way. Gold prices in Cairo dropped for years.

title: London smelled so bad Parliament almost closed
hook: London smelled so bad that Parliament almost closed.
script: In eighteen fifty eight, the Thames was so full of sewage that politicians hung curtains soaked in chemicals. The crisis led to London's modern sewer system.

title: The shortest war in history lasted under an hour
hook: The shortest war in history lasted under an hour.
script: The Anglo Zanzibar War of eighteen ninety six lasted about forty minutes. British ships bombarded the palace, and Zanzibar surrendered.

title: In 1518 a whole city couldn't stop dancing
hook: In fifteen eighteen, a whole city could not stop dancing.
script: In Strasbourg, people reportedly danced for days without rest. Hundreds joined in, and some collapsed. Historians still debate the cause.
